text:
maya (Design): quick sync — prototyping a compact left nav that groups Models + Deployments. label ideas: 'Workloads' or 'Workspaces'?

sam (Frontend): 'Workloads' = explicit; 'Workspaces' = softer. Either's fine if breadcrumbs and routes match.

jonah (PM): routing question: canonical deep link shapes? e.g. /workspace/:id/model/:modelId vs /w/:org/workloads/:type/:id. Simpler wins.

sam (Frontend): prefer /workspace/:id/model/:modelId. fallback behavior: missing modelId -> list view; invalid workspace -> redirect with toast. Also add ?view=compact and ?navMode=compact overrides for demos.

kevin (A11y): a11y nits: breadcrumbs need aria-current on last item; separators aria-hidden; skiplink copy -> "Skip to main navigation". When toggling view via query param, announce change with aria-live polite ("Navigation collapsed"). Truncated crumbs should use aria-label, not title.

maya (Design): copy: replace + with chevron and expose accessible label (Expand/Collapse). Keep 44px hit target on mobile and make row clickable.

navbot (deploy-bot): branch nav-compact-experiments deployed to staging: staging.redwood.internal/nav-test (build 2026.03.22-9).

maya (Design): action items: 1) validate skiplink targets, 2) run SR pass for aria-live and focus order, 3) check breadcrumb contrast, 4) test permalinks preserve view. Quick poll: :thumbsup: icons-only compact, :raised_hand: icons+mini-label.

sam (Frontend): will test in staging and post small fixes.

jonah (PM): I'll collect hallway feedback tomorrow and pick label by EOD.

kevin (A11y): I'll upload SR notes.

maya (Design): if no objections we'll go with 'Workloads' + the a11y tweaks. :sparkles:
